## Working of the Previous Program

![Recursive Method Call With Decreasing Value of n](data:image/png;base64,)

Each Recursive Call is a Distinct Method

An important aspect of recursion is that each recursive call creates a distinct method, even though the method name is the same.

This concept is going to be essential when we learn how to stop infinite recursion.
